NodesRef SelectorQuery.selectAll(string selector)

Select all nodes that match the selector on the current page.

Parameter

string selector

Selector.

Return Value

NodesRef

selector syntax

  • A selector, for example, a CSS selector, supports only the following syntax:

    • IDselector:#the-id
    • Class selector (selects multiple consecutive classes):.a-class.another-class
    • Sub-element selector: .the-parent > .the-child
    • Descendant selector:.the-ancestor .the-descendant
    • Union of multiple selectors: #a-node, .some-other-nodes

Sample Code

const selectorQuery = ma.createSelectorQuery()

selectorQuery.selectAll(".one")
  .boundingClientRect()
  .exec((res) => {
    console.log(res);
  });
